{"reasoning":"The `absent` verdict holds up.

1. **Documentation requirement:** `packages/contracts/src/interfaces/IRaffleFactory.sol:L7-L9` states:
   > `/// @dev The factory has no owner, pause, upgrade, rescue, or mutable protocol configuration. Deployment tooling must`
   > `///      verify that the immutable quote-token address is the target chain's official USDC; onchain construction checks`
   > `///      only code presence and six-decimal metadata.`
   This is reiterated in `packages/contracts/src/RaffleFactory.sol:L59-L61`:
   > `/// @dev The quote token must report exactly six decimals; the wrapper and quote token must contain deployed code.`
   > `///      Deployment tooling must supply and verify the target chain's official USDC address because the constructor`
   > `///      cannot prove token identity from metadata.`
   And `DESIGN.md:L2` states:
   > `Quote token and Chainlink wrapper are trusted canonical dependencies; arbitrary prize contracts and ticket recipients are untrusted.`

2. **Onchain and codebase verification:**
   - In `packages/contracts/src/RaffleFactory.sol:L65-L92`, `constructor(address quoteToken_, address vrfWrapper_, address protocolTreasury_)` validates `quoteToken_` only by calling `_requireContract(quoteToken_)` (`L66`, defined at `L183-L185` as `if (account.code.length == 0) revert NotContract(account);`) and checking `IERC20Metadata(quoteToken_).decimals()` against `RaffleConstants.QUOTE_TOKEN_DECIMALS` (`L70-L78`, where `QUOTE_TOKEN_DECIMALS = 6` at `packages/contracts/src/libraries/RaffleConstants.sol:L24`), plus ensuring `protocolTreasury_ != quoteToken_` (`L80-L83`).
   - In `packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L155-L166`, `constructor(address quoteToken_, address vrfWrapper_)` checks only `if (msg.sender == address(0) || quoteToken_ == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();` (`L159`) before storing `quoteToken = IERC20(quoteToken_);` (`L162`).
   - Neither `RaffleFactory` nor `Raffle` (nor any inherited base contract or library) reads `block.chainid` or checks `quoteToken_` against an allowlist of official per-chain USDC addresses.
   - No deployment scripts, address registries, or offchain deployment verification tooling exist anywhere in the scoped codebase (`packages/contracts`).","refuted":false}
